reason: A session migration and data-processing plugin that imports conversations from many agent tools into native dsh sessions, supports export, privacy redaction, batch discovery, and local knowledge extraction.

summaries.zh: 将多个智能体工具中的会话导入 dsh 原生会话，支持批量发现、双向导出、隐私脱敏和本地知识提取。
summaries.en: Imports conversations from multiple agent tools into native dsh sessions with batch discovery, bidirectional export, privacy redaction, and local knowledge extraction.

capabilities: Reads user-selected local session files and directories
Parses and transforms conversation records from multiple formats
Writes imported sessions, archives, import history, and local knowledge data
Exposes a slash command, service interface, and REST endpoints
Can redact sensitive identifiers such as API keys, contact details, IP addresses, and payment card numbers
Can extract selected knowledge into local memory storage
